finding: Total item sales analysed were R$ 13,591,643.70.
The processed orders dataset contains 99,441 unique orders.
The highest monthly item sales occurred in 2017-11 at R$ 1,010,271.37.
The highest-sales product category was beleza_saude with item sales of R$ 1,258,681.34.
Repeat customers, defined using customer_unique_id and more than one order, represented 3.12% of unique customers.
The payment method with the highest total payment value was credit_card at R$ 12,542,084.19.
The most common review score was 5, with 57,328 reviews.
The average observed delivery duration was 12.56 days based on orders with valid delivery timestamps.
The most common order status was delivered with 96,478 orders.
The Pearson correlation between product price and freight value was 0.4142. This measures association and does not establish causality.
